decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings to the minimum extent possible.

Condition : 4 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building. Supporting beams shall be retained, and if changed because of rot, shall remain visible as a downstand. The nib shall have a minimum depth of 0.2m.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the plans referenced for the ground floor wall opening, the area of demolition shall be restricted to 100mm in any direction from the structural opening.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces herby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - Detailed drawings of all external rainwater, drainage and ventilation goods shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details. The details shall include any secondary outlets and details of the width of the guttering valleys.

Condition : 8 - Detailed drawings of the fascia and fascia joins, at a scale of not less than 1:20 and including elevation, plan and section details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development. The works thereafter shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans.
description: Listed Building consent for the erection of a single storey rear extension and internal alterations
